To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the preferences for choosing convertibles was related to assets/liabilities ratio, MV/BV strongly, and the preferences for choosing common stocks was related to size of company,growht opportunity,volatility of cash flow strongly, which is consistent with the hypothesis of the study.
the preferences for choosing the convertible bonds were strongly and positively related to the size and growth opportunity of company, and the assets-liabilities ratio.

(1) the preferences of Chinese listed companies for choosing convertible bond were related to assets-liability ratio and MV/BVs strongly and negatively;( 2) the preferences of choosing convertible bond were strongly and positively related to size of companies,growth opportunity and volatile of cash flow; (3) there was no significant relationship between age of companies,physical assets ratio, and profitability of companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the motives for issuing convertible bonds of Chinese listed companies.
the factors that affect the choice of convertible bonds by Chinese listed companies, and it provides a reference to investors and managers.

the factors which influence the preferences for choosing convertibles, and the empirical results provide some evidence that the issuing convertible bonds of Chinese listed companies are related to the size and growth opportunity and assets-liabilities ratio of company.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the convertible bonds issuing of Chinese listed companies was mainly related to the size, growth opportunity,assets-liabilities ratio and volatility of cash flows of company.
the preferences for issuing convertible bond was related with the size of company, growth opportunity and volatility of company’s cash flow, assets-liabilities ratio, MV/BV strongly.

, the issuing convertible bond of Chinese listed companies was a kind of financial innovation, and the main motive of issuing convertible bond was to raise the capital, and the issuing convertible bonds was an effective way for the Chinese listed companies to raise capital.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the preferences of Chinese listed companies for convertible bonds was related to the assets-liabilities ratio,MV/BV,company size,growth opportunity and the volatility of cash flow,etc.
the issuing convertible bonds of listed companies in China is a kind of financing way to improve their financial structure.
the convertible bonds issuing was more likely to happen in companies with high assets-liabilities ratio,low MV/BV,large size,growth opportunities and volatility of cash flows.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the issuing convertible bond of listed companies in China is mainly to improve the capital structure and reduce the financing cost.
the issuing motive of convertible bond was similar with the issuing motive of common stock.
Chinese listed companies prefer convertible bonds to common stock when their financial indexes are better than average.
